result.question: Quais são os 10 procedimentos mais comuns?
result.gold_sql: SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(a."id_atendimento") AS total_atendimentos FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS total FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
